query: 金额大于 100000 的已完成订单有哪些？

outcome.sql: SELECT "o"."order_id" AS "order_id", "o"."emp_id" AS "emp_id", "o"."amount" AS "amount", "o"."cost_price" AS "cost_price", "o"."status" AS "status", "o"."order_date" AS "order_date", "o"."region" AS "region" FROM "public"."orders" "o" WHERE "o"."status" = '已完成' AND "o"."amount" > 100000 ORDER BY "o"."order_date" ASC LIMIT 40
